fact: The SSSAMS site states that for academic year 2024 the system holds details of every student, taken each year from class registers, with head teachers adding and removing pupils by SMS and class teachers reporting attendance for individual pupils by SMS; 5,915 open schools of all levels had current enrolment of 10,364 ever identified, data entry was complete for 1,166,301 of 1,249,845 new and transferred learners, direct data entry by schools had been launched, and the system is supported by the ministry's GESS programme funded by UK Aid.
title: South Sudan Schools: Ana Fii Inni
publisher: Girls' Education South Sudan (GESS), Ministry of General Education and Instruction
